file.description: A backup file name from GET /api/auth/setup/backups

key.description: An encrypted backup's emergency kit (its text, or just the AGE-SECRET-KEY-1… line). Without it an encrypted backup 400s with `code: backupKeyRequired`; a wrong one with `backupKeyMismatch`. After the restore the server keeps encrypting backups with that key.

admin.description: The restoring admin's login. If the backup has an account with this email, it's made admin and given this password; otherwise a new admin account is created.
